cells.NVIDIA는 데이터센터용 GPU · CPU · 네트워킹 제품과 이를 묶: NVIDIA is a semiconductor company that designs and sells data center GPUs, CPUs and networking products, the rack-scale systems that combine them, and the software on top. It leaves wafers, advanced packaging and back-end processing to suppliers such as TSMC and owns almost no production plant. From Q1 FY2027 the company reports revenue in two market platforms, Data Center and Edge Computing, and has recast the comparative periods. Data Center was 88.3% of FY2025 revenue and 89.7% of FY2026 revenue, and the rest was Edge Computing: PC, gaming, workstation, automotive and robotics. Data Center revenue is reported in two customer groups, Hyperscale and AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise, but compute, networking and standalone CPUs are no longer reported separately from FY2027.
cells.강점은 CUDA 소프트웨어 생태계와, GPU · CPU · 네트워킹을 랙: The strengths are the CUDA software ecosystem and a system design that combines GPUs, CPUs and networking at rack scale. The company's 10-K names performance, software support, total system cost and customer access as competitive factors, and by industry tallies the company has held most of AI accelerator revenue. Because production is left to suppliers, FY2026 purchases of property and equipment were only 2.8% of revenue. As a precedent of revenue falling sharply despite that lead, in FY2023 a gaming channel inventory correction cut quarterly revenue by more than a quarter between Q1 and Q3. In China, after the US imposed export license requirements, domestic chips such as Huawei's gained ground, and the company's share of China's data center AI chips fell to a little over one third in the first half of 2026.
cells.또한 데이터센터 매출은 소수 고객의 설비투자 계획과 공급사의 첨단 패키징: Data Center revenue is also tied both to a few customers' capital spending plans and to suppliers' advanced packaging and memory capacity. In the first half of FY2027 three direct customers accounted for a little under half of revenue, and the hyperscalers that build custom accelerators are both the company's largest customers and its competitors. The company more than doubled its supply and capacity commitments in a single quarter ahead of demand, and it also guaranteed the credit of data centers to be leased by OpenAI affiliates. Value per share therefore depends heavily on how fast Data Center revenue growth slows after FY2028 and how far competition lowers gross margin.
